definition: The task of converting written text into natural-sounding spoken audio.
details: Modern text-to-speech systems increasingly use neural network architectures (including diffusion and transformer-based models) to produce highly natural, expressive synthetic speech.
story: Picture a translator at the United Nations, listening to one language and whispering the meaning into another in real time. It figures out meaning by noticing which words like to travel together. It does not memorize a rulebook; it absorbs a library. Meaning lives in company — a word is known by the words it keeps. And that is Text-to-Speech — teaching a machine to read between the lines.
